name: Cyber Evolution
storyline: The storyline of the game "Cyber ​ ​ Evolution: The Beginning" takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where the Earth was subjected to chaos after the rebellion of the supermind. The main hope for salvation is "superhumans" with special abilities. Players will have to join Operation Inception to resist the invasion of giant mechamonsters and fight for the survival of the world. The game allows you to freely move around the open world with an area of ​ ​ 600,000 km of ², explore cities, research bases, black markets and even space. Players will develop their character, improve skills, get equipment, unlock vehicles and develop companions, as well as fight alongside beautiful warriors who are powerful allies.
summary: The most anticipated cyber adventure begins in 2025! In a future world where the supermind has risen, the Earth has plunged into chaos. People with special abilities, called "supermen", have become the hope of salvation. They launched an operation codenamed "Inception". And you, as one of the participants, will have to use your powers and go on a new journey!
